hypothesis: A write-and-read-registers request can write before the register mapping when its write address is below start_registers, even though its read range and counts are valid.
evidence_source: Line 953 computes mapping_address_write by subtracting start_registers from the attacker-controlled write address. The address validation at lines 962–965 checks mapping_address < 0 twice and never checks mapping_address_write < 0. Consequently, a negative write index can reach the assignment to mb_mapping->tab_registers[i] at line 980.

expected_behavior: Out-of-bounds writes before the register array, potentially causing heap corruption, a crash, or an AddressSanitizer report.

notes: Requires a mapping with a nonzero start_registers and an otherwise accepted request. The write-count and byte-count checks do not prevent the negative index. Replace the duplicated read-index lower-bound check at line 964 with mapping_address_write < 0.
